experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Pure simulation, no external data, bounded by the number of draws.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether a hierarchical estimator has lower variance than a pooled estimator under group heterogeneity.
experiment_plans.design: Monte Carlo simulation across heterogeneity levels, comparing two estimators per replicate.

data_requirements.description: Simulated grouped observations with configurable between-group and within-group variance.
preprocessing_steps: Generate replicates at each heterogeneity level with a fixed seed

methods.name: pooled mean estimator
methods.description: Ignore group structure and average everything.

methods.name: shrinkage estimator
methods.description: Shrink group means toward the grand mean by a variance-ratio factor.

evaluation.baseline: The pooled estimator at the same heterogeneity level.
evaluation.success_criteria: The shrinkage estimator has lower variance at every heterogeneity level without coverage dropping below 0.90.

risks: Too few replicates would make the variance comparison itself noisy.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
